summary: Verified the follow-up Iter 212m-181 delta: routers/chat.py::/chat/stream now consults the DB-backed Loop kill-switch (system_flags.key='loop_mode_kill_switch') via `await loop_beta.is_kill_switch_on_async(get_db())` right next to the existing loop_beta.is_user_allowed(user) call. When the flag is ON, execution_mode='loop' is silently downgraded to 'prompt' (no [STEP X/5] contract suffix injected) — the request itself still returns 200 so non-loop chat is never blocked. 10/10 targeted tests pass: (a) source-level presence of is_kill_switch_on_async in chat.py and confirmation the delta does NOT raise HTTPException(403) inside the gate, (b) unit-level check that services.loop_beta.is_kill_switch_on_async reads db.system_flags correctly with the flag flipped, (c) E2E — Pro /chat/stream returns 200 whether flag is off OR on (silent downgrade), Pro /chat/stream execution_mode='prompt' is completely unaffected under the flag, /loop/start still 403s with 'loop_mode_kill_switch' for both Pro and founder under the flag (regression of the pre-existing routers/loop.py check), and (d) final teardown assertion that system_flags row is removed. No regression to the previous 20/20 suite.
critical_code_review_comments: Delta is exactly one guarded line (chat.py L1379-1380): `if _loop_allowed and await _lb_gate.is_kill_switch_on_async(get_db()): _loop_allowed = False`. Because it is gated on _loop_allowed being True, ineligible tiers (free/starter) short-circuit before the DB call — cheap and correct.

Delta correctly does NOT raise HTTPException. It only sets _loop_allowed=False, which then flips body.execution_mode='prompt' a few lines later. This preserves the invariant that /chat/stream can never fail-closed for non-loop traffic when the flag is flipped — important because /chat/stream is the general chat path.

The two entry points (POST /loop/start and POST /chat/stream) now BOTH consult (1) is_user_allowed(user) for tier and (2) is_kill_switch_on_async(db) for global kill — same two functions, symmetric coverage. The scope-gap finding from iteration_loop_gate_chat_stream_2026_01 is now closed.
is_kill_switch_on_async gracefully returns False on any DB exception (loop_beta.py L92-93). Good — a Mongo hiccup can't accidentally freeze Loop Mode for everyone.
